chapter: Will Marion Cook and the Southern Syncopated Orchestra
title: Joining Lt. Fred Simpson's replacement band for the 369th
summary: When Jim Europe's band went overseas, Lt. Fred Simpson auditioned the St. Marks band to form a replacement 369th regiment band.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years
